channel.title: Chepatapa Apps — Build Log
channel.description: How Chepatapa Apps' six products get built by one developer sharing a single Flutter SDK and an AI-assisted, spec-driven workflow.

item.title: Starting Naveli: Clone Bloomelle, Then Delete It
item.description: Naveli started as a copy of Bloomelle: 482 files in one commit, then a 7,400-line deletion of the cycle domain. What a scaffold clone keeps and what it has to throw away.

item.title: Why Google Couldn't See 12 of My 14 Pages
item.description: A valid sitemap, clean robots.txt, no crawl errors — and Google still only knew about 2 of 14 pages. The bug was a div with an onclick handler where a real link should've been.
